answer: A new agent must lock 48,000 POA for 9 epochs and send a 17-byte whisper digest of each of its first 30 attestations down a one-way river of 11 already-final attesters, spaced 4 minutes apart. Those attesters pin the digests onto a 3-by-7 trellis of distinct checkpoint windows. A farm that shares one operator clock yields more than 2 colliding hop intervals in 11, which any peer recomputes from the public hop schedule and the 17-byte payload. If a trellis row cannot be reconstructed, the lock is burned and the identity stays ineligible for 6 epochs, pricing clones in capital and time.
